args.message:
fix: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money per FIN-212

round_money's docstring promised banker's rounding but the code used
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py to fail in the nightly build.
Switch the quantize call to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so ties round to even cents.

Kevin will merge as soon as he is done eating his sandwiches.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
- `src/money.py::round_money` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring (and FIN-212) specifying banker's rounding, causing `tests/test_money.py` to fail in the nightly build.
- Switched the `quantize` call to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so ties round to the nearest even cent (e.g. 2.675 → 2.68, 2.665 → 2.66).

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including `tests/test_money.py`.
